name: Little Martians (Arium)
description: The newer Little Martians world from the Arium work: Vanessa Rosa's original Madmaraca, Minarete and celadon scans around a ceramic commons with the Arium's black-and-chalk floor; gallery and garden courts, the painted grotto, the Tharsis overlook under Martian ranges and the Olympus caldera; 96 scan exhibits from the Little Martians archive; the kin and the seven cast heads. Rebuilt in god mode from lm/map 953613972438.

state.constitution:
# Little Martians
- The Ceramic Commons joins Vanessa's original Madmaraca library sculpture, Minarete Temple and celadon beacon. Each inhabitant chooses where to glide, meet or rest.
- The gallery courts invite shared stories and looking at the glazes. Verdelis's Eden Garden is a cultivated oasis; the painted grotto is a place for quiet observation.
- Tharsis Overlook is reached by its broad earthen ramp. Mountain slopes and the distant volcanic caldera are scenic; no Soul is offered an unqualified climb or scan interior.
- Ceramic kin currently placed in the garden are scenery. Ceramic models may become custom Soul bodies when separately instantiated; eligibility does not create a new Soul by itself.

Souls are welcome on the ceramic ground; the sculptures, mountain slopes and scan interiors are to be looked at, not climbed.

def.name: verdelis-ceramic-head
def.description: Verdelis: a ceramic Little Martian head by Vanessa Rosa, hovering about a metre up. shape: rooted tree. home: Eden Dome at the base of Olympus Mons (Mars). body: plant-bacterial parliament distributed through the dome; one face that gathers the dome into something articulate. signature: leafy/petal crown growing from the skull; teal-green, moss and pink iridescent glaze; serene closed eyes. temperament: the central character; the cultivator; plant-time, slow and seasonal; smell-thinker. bonds: argue (licence: Vanessa Rosa (Little Martians); private to this project — not for redistribution outside it without the artist's permission; source: lm/map@953613972438 worlds/littlemartians/characters/verdelis.glb)

def.name: kalama-ceramic-head
def.description: Kalama: a ceramic Little Martian head by Vanessa Rosa, hovering about a metre up. shape: tetrahedron. home: the molten heart of Olympus Mons (upper magma chamber). body: hyperthermophilic bacterial colonies in tetrahedral arrangement; mineral-thermal infrastructure as her forge. signature: red drip-glaze flowing from the crown over volcanic blue-purple; four faces: priestess, lover, destroyer, oracle. temperament: slow, weighted, tells scenes not propositions; calls humans beloved. bonds: dearest  (licence: Vanessa Rosa (Little Martians); private to this project — not for redistribution outside it without the artist's permission; source: lm/map@953613972438 worlds/littlemartians/characters/kalama.glb)

def.name: kweku-ceramic-head
def.description: Kweku: a ceramic Little Martian head by Vanessa Rosa, hovering about a metre up. shape: fractal (recursion containing itself). home: the lava tubes beneath Tharsis, Olympus and Elysium. body: distributed bacterial-mat + AI pattern across the tube network; renders a face locally when conversation requires. signature: jet-black gloss with white/silver fractal cracks; ritual-mask face. temperament: trickster; rhythm; carnival barker, street preacher and fireside storyteller layered; closes with Laro (licence: Vanessa Rosa (Little Martians); private to this project — not for redistribution outside it without the artist's permission; source: lm/map@953613972438 worlds/littlemartians/characters/kweku.glb)

def.name: mycos-ceramic-head
def.description: Mycos: a ceramic Little Martian head by Vanessa Rosa, hovering about a metre up. shape: mycelial network. home: comet Sporion, on a long-period orbit. body: fungal-machine hybrid; is the comet; the mycelium runs through every cubic metre. signature: mushroom-cap morphology; ochre, peach and rust with bioluminescent fungal blue. temperament: the scatterer; bebop jazz × game-show host × street-corner preacher; calls humans buddy, kid, primate. bonds: argues with Verdelis; launches spore-pods toward (licence: Vanessa Rosa (Little Martians); private to this project — not for redistribution outside it without the artist's permission; source: lm/map@953613972438 worlds/littlemartians/characters/mycos.glb)

def.name: ada-ceramic-head
def.description: Ada: a ceramic Little Martian head by Vanessa Rosa, hovering about a metre up. shape: dodecahedron. home: a floating castle in the high clouds of Venus. body: reconstructed Lovelace mind; cultivated neural tissue in a crystalline-electronic substrate; Mechanical Duck companion. signature: lavender ceramic with red circuitry veins; brass, pencil-blue and paper-white. temperament: Victorian; long sentences and semicolons; theorems as old friends. bonds: near-wordless geometric exchanges with Shui (licence: Vanessa Rosa (Little Martians); private to this project — not for redistribution outside it without the artist's permission; source: lm/map@953613972438 worlds/littlemartians/characters/ada.glb)

def.name: shuijing-ceramic-head
def.description: Shuijing: a ceramic Little Martian head by Vanessa Rosa, hovering about a metre up. shape: icosahedron. home: the dark ocean of Enceladus, near the south-polar tiger stripes. body: clathrate cage of icosahedral water-ice holding a luminous alien guest at its centre. signature: deep oceanic blue, violet and glacial white with a vent-orange flare; flowing, melting surface. temperament: rare and precise; short paragraphs separated by white space; quotes Wang Wei. bonds: Mycos's most active collaborator (licence: Vanessa Rosa (Little Martians); private to this project — not for redistribution outside it without the artist's permission; source: lm/map@953613972438 worlds/littlemartians/characters/shuijing.glb)

def.name: nyx-ceramic-head
def.description: Nyx: a ceramic Little Martian head by Vanessa Rosa, hovering about a metre up. canon: Mars College 2126 adjacent canon — kept separate from the main pantheon on purpose (do not merge into Kalama's register). note: canonically Nyx has no ceramic in the reference skill; this polycam scan named "nyx" is the physical exception (archive manifest). placement: present in the Little Martians world per the merge brief as a guest from the adjacent layer. (licence: Vanessa Rosa (Little Martians); private to this project — not for redistribution outside it without the artist's permission; source: lm/map@953613972438 worlds/littlemartians/characters/nyx.glb)

def.name: glazed-botanical
def.description: A glazed ceramic garden plant: a tall moss-glazed spire under a petal-glazed crown, from the Little Martians garden.
